description: Check a campaign list against a do-not-contact list before sending: exact email matches and, optionally, whole suppressed domains, with a per-company cap. Returns what was removed and why, and the clean CSV when it is 500 rows or fewer.

csv.description: The campaign CSV as text, header row first.

matchDomains.description: A suppressed domain removes everyone at it. Defaults to true.

maxPerCompany.description: Cap contacts per company domain; 0 for no cap. Defaults to 0.

suppression.description: Addresses and domains not to contact, one per line.

suppressionCsv.description: Or the do-not-contact list as a CSV.

name: check_suppression
title: Suppression list check
